design: guarded n=10 pilot on the same first-10 SROIE eval docs (paired 3B control), memory watchdog armed; full n=100 attempt abandoned after crashing the 16GB host (documented below)

hardware.full_n100_attempt: crashed the host (reboot) on 2026-09-25; 6 client timeouts at 180s preceded the crash (server wedge)
hardware.pilot_safeguards: TINYDOC_OLLAMA_TIMEOUT=600, memory watchdog (watch_mem.sh), machine otherwise idle

rationale: No measurable quality gap on the paired subset (F1 identical 0.975; ANLS +0.018 for 7B is within n=10 noise and both are at ceiling), 7B is 4.5x slower per doc (15.0s vs 3.4s) and destabilized a 16GB host on the full run. 3B stays the default; 7B not adopted as a quality tier on this hardware class.
